meta.name: batch-processing-jobs
meta.description: Implement robust batch processing systems with job queues, schedulers, background tasks, and distributed workers. Use when processing large datasets, scheduled tasks, async operations, or resource-intensive computations.

copy.tagline: 用队列和调度器自动处理大批量任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理大量数据或执行定时后台任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate large-scale batch processing with queues and schedulers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to process large datasets or run scheduled background tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能够帮助你设计和实现批处理系统，包括作业队列、调度器、后台任务和分布式工作者。它会提供代码示例和最佳实践建议。
howto.when: 当你需要处理大型数据集、定时任务、异步操作或资源密集型计算时触发，例如批量数据更新或报告生成。

say.text: 帮我创建一个作业队列来处理批量数据。
say.note: Claude 会提供使用 Bull Queue 的示例代码。

say.text: 如何实现带重试逻辑的后台任务？
say.note: Claude 会建议指数退避和死信队列。

say.text: 我需要定时运行数据导入作业。
say.note: Claude 会展示 Cron 调度器的用法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design and implement batch processing systems including job queues, schedulers, background tasks, and distributed workers. It provides code examples and best practices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to process large datasets, scheduled tasks, async operations, or resource-intensive computations, such as bulk data updates or report generation.

say_en.text: Create a job queue for processing bulk data.
say_en.note: Claude provides example code using Bull Queue.

say_en.text: How to implement background tasks with retry logic?
say_en.note: Claude suggests exponential backoff and dead letter queues.

say_en.text: I need a scheduled job for data import.
say_en.note: Claude shows usage of a Cron scheduler.
